central_comic_situation: Neet tries to look natural while smuggling olives, then voluntarily becomes conspicuous luggage. Feeling: affectionate travel exhaustion and comic homecoming relief.

wants.Neet: Bring olives home and turn every procedural delay into his triumph.
wants.Buddy: Get Heather and luggage through the exit so his next nap remains in one country.
wants.collision: Buddy tries three sensible steps; Neet makes himself a fourth item to retrieve.

variant_decision: All three complete archived encodings compared independently. reader44 is equivalent prose; reader45 adds formatting emphasis. No distinct narrative alternative warrants separate invented variant or artwork.

comparison.previous_working: Every original incident and strong punchline retained; adds short causal Buddy arc, no unnecessary subplot. Existing warm collar hold preserved instead of historical kick/hate.
comparison.original: Historical TSA/beagle speaking authority, food denial, absurd eaten-evidence release, Heather/dogs household preserved as fiction; no policy fact correction or added Sagar. Prior removal of pretended disownership remains documented by original recovery.
comparison.complete_final_reread: Read complete revised text after embedding all three images. Corrected detector gaze microbeat to keep sniffing at illustration anchor. Source incidents and ending retained.

selected_images.placement_after: Neet pressed his little bag behind his forelegs. Buddy looked straight ahead with the fierce concentration of a dog who had never met an olive.
selected_images.alt_text: Neet hides the bag while Buddy concentrates on looking innocent.

selected_images.placement_after: Buddy followed along the stationary edge as Neet rotated like a rotisserie chicken. He stopped at the next clear gap and barked. If Neet insisted on being luggage, someone had to be there to collect him.
selected_images.alt_text: Buddy waits at the clear pickup gap while Neet enjoys becoming part of the baggage.

selected_images.placement_after: He took one careful step away from the bag, then stopped. What if leaving looked suspicious? The beagle kept sniffing. Buddy stayed exactly where he was.
selected_images.alt_text: The detector beagle finds the bag while Buddy freezes one careful step away.
